title: Pocketwire Personal Account Purchase Protection Terms
content:
### Terms in force

1. **Coverage.** Purchase protection on the Pocketwire Personal Account covers only a payment sent whose payment type is goods and services, when the item was not received or was significantly not as described; personal payments are never covered, even when they paid for goods, and a goods-and-services payment the customer did not authorize is handled as an unauthorized claim instead.
2. **Protection window.** The claim is accepted only within the protection window: the claim is filed no later than the plan's purchase protection claim window in calendar days after the goods-and-services payment's transaction date. The protection window is counted in calendar days from the goods-and-services payment's transaction date, the day after the payment being day 1, and a claim filed on the last day of the window is accepted. The transaction date and payment type are read from the system record of the disputed payment.
3. **One claim per payment.** The one-claim-per-payment exclusion of unauthorized-payment claims applies to purchase protection claims too: a claim is filed only if no earlier claim of any type or outcome exists on the same payment.

### Retired term

The earlier term under which purchase protection claims carried no customer liability and no provisional credit, the claims team recorded approved or denied, and an approval reimbursed the lower of the claim amount and the plan's maximum reimbursable amount as a claim reimbursement together with the refund of any credit card funding fee charged on that payment, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for purchase protection reimbursements of the Pocketwire Personal Account.

### Which payments are covered

| Payment | Covered by purchase protection? |
|---|---|
| Goods-and-services payment sent, item not received | Yes |
| Goods-and-services payment sent, item significantly not as described | Yes |
| Personal payment sent, even one that paid for goods | No |
| Goods-and-services payment the customer did not authorize | No — handled as an unauthorized claim |

### Window boundary (hypothetical, a 180-day window)

- Claim filed on the 180th calendar day after the payment's transaction date: accepted.
- Claim filed on the 181st calendar day: not accepted.

superseded_clauses: Purchase protection claims carry no customer liability and no provisional credit; the claims team records approved or denied, and an approval reimburses the lower of the claim amount and purchase_protection_max_amount as a wallet_claim_reimbursement, together with the refund of any credit card funding fee charged on that payment.
